title: Bible ABCs Quiz — Letters A through E
description: Match each letter to its Bible word! Let's see what you remember!

questions.question: A is for ___. Who was the first man God made?
questions.explanation: A is for Adam! God made Adam, the very first man, from the dust of the ground (Genesis 2:7).

questions.question: B is for ___. Where was baby Jesus born?
questions.explanation: B is for Bethlehem! Baby Jesus was born in the town of Bethlehem (Matthew 2:1).

questions.question: C is for ___. What do we call everything God made?
questions.explanation: C is for Creation! Creation means everything God made — the sky, animals, trees, and people (Genesis 1:1).

questions.question: D is for ___. Who was the brave boy who trusted God?
questions.explanation: D is for David! David was a brave boy who trusted God and later became a great king (1 Samuel 17:45).

questions.question: E is for ___. What was the name of God's beautiful garden?
questions.explanation: E is for Eden! The Garden of Eden was the beautiful garden God made for Adam and Eve (Genesis 2:8).
